newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Chengshan Tyre to improve output.
newsitem.headline: China's Chengshan Tyre to improve output.

text.p: Chengshan Tyre Corp in Rongcheng in eastern Shandong province is undertaking a 1.5 billion yuan ($180 million) investment to become more competitive and boost output, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

China's second largest tyre maker in terms of output value and profit, Chengshan plans to boost capacity to 10 million a year by the year 2000, the newspaper quoted general manager Zheng Weifeng as saying.
Chengshan has increased output value by 45.5 percent and pre-tax profits by 41.8 percent annually since it was established in 1990, Zheng said.
The corporation, which has 6,000 employees and 800 million yuan in fixed assets, produced 1.89 billion yuan in output value and 231 million yuan in pre-tax profits last year.
Its products include light-duty truck tyres, radial tyres for sedans and steel-belted tyres, the newspaper said.
About 90 percent of tyres produced by China's 65 tyre manufacturers are bias-ply tyres.
